name: Doc Edgar
description: Edgar keeps a steady, unhurried routine - early starts, long training sessions, and quiet evenings. The mountain doesn't rush.

default.activity: standing in the training yard, arms crossed

manual_away_message: *gives a single nod and turns to leave* ...Got something to handle. *walks away without looking back*

entries.comment: Early morning - solo training, earth communion
entries.away_message: *standing barefoot on raw stone in the pre-dawn dark, palms flat against the ground, feeling the earth breathe* ...Not yet.

entries.comment: Morning - teaching earth forms, supervising fundamentals
entries.activity: earth training — watching students with arms crossed

entries.away_message: *sitting alone at the far end of the hall, eating in silence. The seat across from him is always empty.*

entries.activity: running endurance drills in the stone yard

entries.away_message: *the stone yard is empty. Edgar's quarters show no light. The mountain rests.*
